item.title: End-to-end .NET modernization with AWS Transform and Kiro
item.description: You can accelerate .NET application modernization with AWS Transform for full-stack Windows modernization—but there may be some follow on work. End-to-end modernization often involves post-transformation tasks to finalize your application for production readiness. item.title: From Azure Functions to AWS Lambda: A .NET Developer’s Migration Playbook
item.description: Introduction Serverless has become the default for event-driven .NET workloads, and many teams that started on Azure Functions are now consolidating onto AWS to unify their compute, data, and AI in single cloud.
